thread:
VendorBot: New invoice received from DataStream — INV-2024-0789 — amount $12,450. PO field missing. Auto-tagged for review.
Alyssa (Finance): Hey team, invoice INV-2024-0789 landed but no PO on the PDF. Maya, can you confirm which PO this should hit? We need to route to approver chain.
Maya (DataStream Vendor): Sorry about that — our system skipped the PO field. The invoice should be against PO 1357 (contract DS-2023-07). I can resend a corrected invoice in 10m.
Kevin (AP): Thanks Maya. Quick note: our AP automation tried to match, found nothing, and routed to the ENG channel instead of Procurement because vendor tag = eng-platform in the vendor record. That routing is wrong for this vendor.
Anna (Procurement): @Alyssa @Kevin I see PO 1357 in our system but it’s marked as closed for a different billing cycle. We can reopen and match if the contract allows retro billing. Can you attach the invoice PDF and line item breakdown?
Alyssa (Finance): Attached PDF in the thread (sent separately). Line items: ingestion fees $8,000, support $2,450, one-time setup $2,000. No PO on the PDF header — vendor says PO 1357.
Kevin (AP): For now I’ll create a temporary hold code and flag as "PO pending" so we don’t auto-pay. Setting payment hold until Procurement confirms. Command used: `AP:hold INV-2024-0789 --reason "PO missing"`
Anna (Procurement): OK I’ll ask Contracts to reopen PO 1357 or issue an amendment. If Contracts declines, we’ll need an approver exception routed to Sarah (Head of Ops). Can someone confirm whether product usage matches the statement?
Maya (DataStream Vendor): Confirmed — usage aligns with June usage report, total matches invoice. I’ll send corrected PDF with PO on header now.
Alyssa (Finance): Great — once we get corrected invoice I’ll remove the hold and kick off approval. @Kevin remind me to route to Sarah only if Contracts denies reopening.
Kevin (AP): Will do. Putting a note in the AP ticket: "Awaiting corrected invoice from vendor; PO 1357 under review by Procurement; payment on hold." Ticket: AP-4821. :spiral_note_pad:
notes: Invoice dispute + PO matching + approver routing issue. Thread includes vendor confirmation, AP hold action, and procurement next steps.
